title: Context windows in 60 seconds
caption: Context windows in 60 seconds: the model's working memory, and what happens when a conversation outgrows it.

scenes.say: Everything a model can see at once, the instructions, your messages, any documents, and its own reply, has to fit in one window.
When the window fills up, something has to give.

items.title: Retrieve
items.say: Or kept outside and fetched back only when needed.

scenes.code:
context = system prompt
        + conversation
        + documents
        + the reply
scenes.say: It's measured in tokens, and a bigger window costs more to fill on every call.

scenes.text:
If it's not in the window,
*it doesn't exist.*
scenes.say: The model has no memory outside it. That's a context window.
